title: docs: the external-systems guide gains the OData datasource section and the three-way choice (declarative OData, plugin driver, DataSync mirror) — epic #27261 P2
body:

type: Feature

## 维护者速读

- **做什么：** 指南加一节：用 OData 声明式接入 SAP / Dynamics 365 的完整示例，以及什么时候该写插件驱动、什么时候该用 DataSync 同步成真表。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## Task

- [ ] `content/docs/data-modeling/virtual-objects.mdx` (or a sibling page): an OData datasource + object binding example, pushdown and the floor explained, write gates, auth through `credentialsRef` and (once landed) a connector instance.
- [ ] The three-way rule: OData endpoint available ⇒ declarative; no OData, computed rows or a private API ⇒ plugin driver; slow-changing reference data ⇒ real object + DataSync.
- [ ] A note that Salesforce exposes no OData for its own data, so it takes a driver of its own.

`Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.
